variables.name: utility/heading
variables.description: Heading colour (navy on light surfaces). A surface that paints its own foreground — brand band, brand card — resets headings to its content colour.

variables.name: utility/logo-ink
variables.description: logo.css: the ink of the GMH mark (--logo-mark-ink) and crest lockup (--logo-crest-ink) on paper — primary, then on-surface after .dark (not primary: M3's dark primary is a light blue meant for controls; the designer's dark colourway is white). Inside a brand band both become on-brand-band (section.css); that is the White colourway here.

variables.name: utility/graphic-ink
variables.description: graphics.css: the graphics kit's line work and navy fills on paper — primary, then on-surface-variant after .dark (not primary: M3's dark primary is a light blue meant for controls). On a brand band the ink is on-brand-band, which the kit's Ground=Brand variants bind directly. The GMH mark inside a graphic uses utility/logo-ink instead.
